description:
The overhaul finishes with no unresolved internal link, anchor, local citation or addressable-item reference on the permanent surface or in any executed archive.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The mechanical documentation check passes over the final footprint with no unresolved internal link, anchor, local citation or addressable-item reference.
- [hard] REQ-02: A link scan of each container archive directory executed during the overhaul reports no unresolved internal link.
- [hard] REQ-03: A link scan of each relocated historical artifact (legacy mirror and moved decks) reports no unresolved internal link.
- [hard] REQ-04: A linked verification record states the commit verified and each scan's result.
title: Verify links across the permanent surface and executed archives
